subject: Cpptraj: is it possible to perform 2D RMSD analysis from average data of several simulations?

messages.author: Nikolay Kuzmich
messages.body:
Dear Amber users and developers,
I wanted to ask you if it is possible to get 2D RMSD matrix averaged from several independent production runs.
Kind regards
Nick

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
You can include multiple trajin filr. I am not sure what you mean by
averaged. Since the axes of the plot are frame number or time, there is no
averaging.
On Mon, Nov 11, 2024, 5:35 AM Nikolay Kuzmich via AMBER <amber.ambermd.
org>
wrote:
> Dear Amber users and developers,
> I wanted to ask you if it is possible to get 2D RMSD matrix averaged from
> several independent production runs.
> Kind regards
> Nick
>

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
Yes you can do it it, but of course the interpretation is up to you. It can
be helpful for comparing the trajectories.

ac.il> wrote:
